data.define: Used about music or food that is excellent.

example.text: Turn it up! This new song really slaps.

misuse.text: Don't say 'that slaps' about a school lecture.

publish.title: What does "that slaps" mean?
publish.value: That slaps = That is really good. Example: "Turn it up! This new song really slaps." (very casual English, US).
